_about: Shared settings for every Meshy model (tools/meshy/meshy.py). Change these and every later model follows; already-made models keep the style they were made with. The suffixes are appended to each asset's prompt (max 800 characters in all).

prompt_suffix.nodes: Temperate Northern Europe in the Iron Age, natural and believable, realistic bark, foliage and stone, muted natural palette. Game asset for a top-down real-time strategy game: one object standing on flat ground, clear readable silhouette, no base plate, no people, no text.
prompt_suffix.buildings: Ancient Northern European village, Iron Age to early medieval, Celtic and Germanic: rough-hewn timber, wattle and daub, straw thatch, fieldstone. Weathered, hand-made, believable, muted earthy palette. Game asset for a top-down real-time strategy game: one building standing on flat ground, clear readable silhouette, no base plate, no people, no text.

texture_suffix.nodes: Realistic natural materials, muted greens and browns, soft even lighting, no baked shadows.
texture_suffix.buildings: Realistic hand-made materials: weathered timber, straw thatch, daub plaster, rough stone; muted earthy palette of warm browns, ochre, grey stone and moss green; soft even lighting, no baked shadows.
